corrclip.scope: supplementary cached-mask consumer timing, NOT end-to-end
corrclip.reason: The original E1 implementation reads official pre-generated SAM2 image masks. Their construction cost was not logged.
corrclip.measurement: Masks preloaded outside timing to match the decoded-RGB input convention; mask transfer and full consumer inference remain timed.
corrclip.followup: corrclip_online measures the native online SAM2-8 path on the same 100 images; do not pair this variant with the original cached-mask E1 quality or call it the same recipe.

freeda.scope: online inference after class-specific prototype retrieval; offline corpus construction unavailable
freeda.reason: Pre-existing index and prototype corpus are method artifacts. Class retrieval/setup is measured separately; corpus generation time is unknown, not zero.

cliptrase.reason: Its original E1 evaluation used center-cropped GT. Does not imply full-frame spatial coverage.

software: FreeDA uses its original Torch 1.12.1 environment; other methods use Torch 2.12. Same GPU, batch size, CPU threads, synchronization and sample set; native model dtype/geometry retained.
cpu_thread_scope: cpu_threads=4 denotes torch intra/inter-op and OMP_NUM_THREADS/MKL_NUM_THREADS/OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS. Other native library settings are not overridden.
